subject: maths
question: Find the quotient when the mean proportional of 7(1)/(5) and 245 is divided by an even prime number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the mixed fraction to an improper fraction: 7 1/5 = 36/5

Mean proportional = √(36/5 × 245) = √(36 × 49) = 6 × 7 = 42

The only even prime number in mathematics is 2.

Required quotient = 42 ÷ 2 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 7 1/5 = 36/5

Second number (b) = 245

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between two numbers a and b = √(a × b)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e43889617d44be5b89addc1d33c4822a2b9e5e7e6ec0c9f47f9cc0668891e78c.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mean proportional = √(36/5 × 245)

⇒ Mean proportional = √(36 × 49)

⇒ Mean proportional = 6 × 7 = 42

⇒ The only even prime number is 2.

⇒ Required quotient = 42 ÷ 2 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) of two numbers a and b is given by the formula √(a × b). It acts as the middle term in a continuous proportion where a : x = x : b.

Third and Fourth Proportionals

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional is evaluated as b² ÷ a. For three separate numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional is evaluated as (b × c) ÷ a.

Even Prime Number

A prime number is a positive integer greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct divisors: 1 and itself. The number 2 is uniquely the smallest prime number and the only even prime number.
